text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months. Grey: the margin. Positive means CEDA's error is larger. Solar: two fits, both-eras and era-0-trained. All rows are exploratory.'
text.tspan: Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months. Grey: the margin.
Positive means CEDA's error is larger. Solar: two fits, both-eras and era-0-trained.
